summary: Jinneng revised PP export offers up (FOB Qingdao) post-holiday; import PP from China risen sharply
Domestic NSRP 114G / BSR T3034 VND 39,500-40,000; HCMC T3034 to 40,200, Hyosung raised
Chinese-origin PP in domestic market only edged up slightly; Sibur PP yarn VND 38,700 at Hai Phong (limited)
paras: According to ICIS assessments released on last week's final trading day, October 9, the PP yarn/injection price level in Vietnam last week held at the minimum level and rose USD 20/tonne at the maximum level, to around USD 1,270-1,320/tonne/CFR Vietnam; PP BOPP Film fell USD 20/tonne at the minimum level, to USD 1,300-1,330/tonne.

Market trading activity remained affected by buyers' cautious sentiment amid unpredictable swings in crude oil prices and input costs. On the supply side, uncertainty over delivery schedules and import supply has yet to decisively affect buying decisions. However, the outlook for PP supply in Asia may improve once some plants restart after maintenance and output in China recovers.

Today, October 12, on the first trading day of the new week, China's Jinneng plant revised its PP export offers on an FOB Qingdao (China) basis to Vietnamese buyers, for November 2026 delivery. Accordingly, Jinneng's PP yarn/injection/BOPP offers edged up a further USD 5/tonne (after rising sharply by up to USD 70 last week), to USD 1,365-1,375/tonne/FOB. Some buyers were quoted CIF at USD 1,405-1,415/tonne.

Domestically, on last week's final trading day, PP offers from traders edged up again (after easing in the first half of the week). Today, a survey found firmer sentiment holding, with sellers' adjustment trend ranging from flat to edging slightly higher, and few sellers recorded accepting price cuts.

Accordingly, domestically sourced PP yarn/injection grades such as NSRP's 114G and BSR's T3034 were commonly at VND 39,500-40,000/kg including VAT. “In the north, actual transaction prices for PP 114G today may be at VND 39,300-39,400/kg including VAT, only VND 100-200/kg below the offer,” a source said.

In HCMC, one distributor offered PP T3034 at VND 40,200/kg including VAT, and Hyosung Vina's PP yarn/injection was also recorded with offers raised to VND 40,000/kg including VAT… Domestic supply and operating rates at domestic producers remained stable.

Notably, although import PP offers from China have risen sharply, in the domestic market Chinese-origin PP has only edged up slightly and is not much different from Vietnamese-origin PP. Currently, some Petrochina and Jinneng (China) PP yarn/injection grades are offered at VND 39,500-40,200/kg including VAT, and PP copolymer in the range of VND 39,900-40,500/kg including VAT in the north.
Russia's Sibur PP yarn was quoted to some processing buyers at VND 38,700/kg including VAT at Hai Phong port, in limited volumes…

summary: ICIS: PE levels mixed w/w; one distributor adjusted China re-export offers today
Spot LDPE Film north VND 45,000-46,500 (flat); spot PE mostly flat to slightly easing
November delivery firmer: Sabic LLDPE Film 118WJ/222WJ/222NJ/218BJ at VND 40,500-42,500
paras: According to ICIS assessments released on last week's final trading day, PE price levels in Vietnam last week showed mixed movements. Specifically, LLDPE Film held at the minimum price level but fell USD 80/tonne at the maximum, to USD 1,490-1,520/tonne/CFR. HDPE Film and HDPE Inj fell USD 20-40/tonne at the minimum level, to USD 1,250-1,340 and USD 1,130-1,220/tonne/CFR respectively. Meanwhile, LDPE Film and HDPE Blow held flat.

Buyer sentiment remained cautious as downstream demand shows no clear sign of recovery, while cost pressure and cash flow continue to weigh on converters' purchasing plans. Naphtha and crude oil feedstock costs remain important factors shaping PE prices in Asia. In the short term, geopolitical risks and instability in shipping operations may continue to support production costs, especially for producers using naphtha as feedstock. However, the outlook of improving supply, rising production capacity and still-weak consumption demand may limit room for price increases.

Today, October 12, one distributor adjusted its offers for many PE products of various origins re-exported from China to the Vietnamese market, quoted on an FOB basis from major Chinese ports. Accordingly, offers for LLDPE products of Sabic, OQ, Equate and Exxon were all raised sharply by USD 50/tonne from their own offers early last week, commonly at USD 1,320-1,340/tonne/FOB, while Reliance (India) LLDPE Film JF-19020 was up sharply by USD 70/tonne to USD 1,370/tonne/FOB… The CIF price to Vietnam typically adds USD 30-50/tonne over the FOB offers above.

In domestic trading, the market continued to show a split, with spot PE mostly holding flat or even easing slightly; conversely, offers for far-forward November-delivery PE continued to rise further from last week. The price gap between spot and far-forward material has narrowed considerably. This partly reflects that current PE price levels are at a strong resistance threshold and harder to raise; and partly reflects the outlook that PE prices over the next month will remain high rather than cool clearly versus earlier expectations.

Specifically, in the north, spot LDPE Film transaction price levels are being offered at VND 45,000-46,500/kg including VAT depending on grade, flat from late last week; LLDPE Film/injection held at VND 41,500-42,500/kg including VAT (flat to slightly lower versus late last week); and HDPE offers ranged VND 39,000-42,500/kg including VAT…

Conversely, for November delivery, today one distributor offered Sabic LLDPE Film grades such as 118WJ, 222WJ, 222NJ and 218BJ… at VND 40,500-42,500/kg including VAT depending on grade; grade 218WJ alone was offered as high as VND 44,300-44,400/kg including VAT. It offered Qamar's LLDPE FD21HN and FD21HS at VND 42,500-42,700/kg including VAT at port; Baofeng and CNPC (China)-origin LLDPE Film 7042/7047/7050 at VND 41,200-41,700/kg including VAT, with coal-based material from Ningmei offered at VND 39,600/kg including VAT; HDPE blow 5502S and 5502BN of Yulong (China) and Marlex (US) origin at VND 39,700-39,900/kg including VAT; and Saudi Arabia's HDPE blow 5502BN at VND 41,300/kg including VAT…

summary: Dalian PVC futures edged up slightly; China-to-Vietnam PVC offers limited, even scarce
North coal-based SG-5 commonly VND 23,000-23,300; levels paused/flat after mid-week dip
AGC Vina & TPC Vina held VND 23,800-24,000; a slight recovery attempt noted
paras: The settlement price of PVC futures on the Dalian Commodity Exchange (China) in today's (October 12) first trading session of the week edged up by just under USD 2/tonne from late last week. This is also a price level at which the resin has fluctuated little since October 8, when China returned after a one-week holiday.

Even so, PVC offers from China to Vietnam have recently been fairly limited, even slightly scarce. As a result, many domestic PVC sellers currently do not have much Chinese-origin PVC to offer for prompt delivery. Price levels for Chinese-origin oil-based and coal-based PVC remain lower than for material of other origins, but the price gap is no longer large.

In a survey today, in the north, offers for Chinese-origin coal-based SG-5 PVC from trading companies were still commonly VND 23,000-23,300/kg including VAT; settled prices were fairly close to offers, with few deals now recorded at VND 22,500/kg including VAT. Chinese-origin oil-based PVC was commonly offered at around VND 23,500/kg including VAT…

Overall, after the dip in the middle of last week, PVC offer levels from domestic trading distributors have paused, mostly holding flat. A slight recovery in the Chinese market in last week's closing session and early this week has also helped domestic sentiment brighten, with sellers holding prices firm even though trading is still slow.

Accordingly, PVC offers from the two domestic plants, AGC Vina and TPC Vina, held at VND 23,800-24,000/kg including VAT; Philrex (Philippines) PVC PR1000 was offered at VND 23,500-23,600/kg including VAT and delivery. US Shintech PVC SE950/SE1000 was commonly offered at VND 23,400-24,200/kg including VAT depending on the seller…
